authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 390-386 (even side, 1914), 2024-12-11 overcast strip. 386-388: two mirrored 3-axis halves, flat heads under brick lintels, a balcony stack on each centre axis, a dormer each, two round-arched shop windows (kinker-1902-balcony-axis, two modules; the cluster gave kinker-1890-brick-arched, but there are no white blocks). 390 is under scaffold sheeting on the strip; its front is read from the 2020-02-07 zoom crop (pand-reference-kinkerstraat/0363100012071767): 3 axes, a pointed street gable with a hexagonal light, a white-painted cafe ground storey.
